FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    flowLow   : BOOL;
    ackBtn    : BOOL;
    sensorOK  : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    alarmActive : BOOL;
    alarmAcked  : BOOL;
    highHigh    : BOOL;
END_VAR

    prev_flowLow  : BOOL := FALSE;
    prev_ackBtn   : BOOL := FALSE;
    prev_alarmActive : BOOL := FALSE;
    prev_alarmAcked  : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR
VAR_TEMP
    ackRising : BOOL;
END_VAR
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
   ...
*)
    ackRising := ackBtn AND NOT prev_ackBtn;
    ...
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

When `flowLow` becomes FALSE, the alarm acknowledges if it was active but not yet acknowledged. On the acknowledgment rising edge, the alarm acknowledges if it's active, then clears both flags if the condition has cleared; otherwise it stays active but acknowledged. For persistent conditions, the alarm maintains its state across scans when the condition remains present but isn't yet acknowledged. If the condition clears while unacknowledged, I move to unacknowledged-cleared. An acknowledgment in that cleared state resets everything back to idle.

- `alarmAcked` TRUE whenever acknowledgment has been received (either during active condition or after condition cleared)

- alarmActive becomes FALSE when user acknowledges the cleared state
- alarmAcked becomes TRUE when user acknowledges, or when condition clears without prior acknowledgment
- alarmAcked becomes FALSE when user acknowledges the cleared state
